chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Let not one of you prolong the hair of his armpit, for indeed Satan takes it as a hiding place to conceal himself with it.'
ai.seo_question: Why should Muslims keep their armpit hair short according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) connects the physical act of grooming (fitrah) with spiritual vigilance, illustrating how Satan exploits bodily spaces for concealment. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the interplay between external purity and internal spiritual awareness, where physical habits serve as reminders of divine presence and satanic influence.
